login.title: Welcome back.
login.intro: Sign in with your Factored ID or choose a synthetic customer profile.
login.demo_warning: No password is required because every profile and transaction is synthetic. Never use this pattern for real banking access.
login.judges_help: create a profile, then sign in with its Factored ID for the guided first experience. Choosing a customer opens the demo without onboarding.
login.factored_help: Enter the six-digit ID generated when the demo account was created.
login.customer_help: Search ignores capitalization and accents. A short profile label distinguishes customers with the same name without exposing document numbers.
login.no_matches: No demo customers match that name.
login.load_customers_error: We could not load demo customers. Please try again.
login.select_customer_error: Search for a customer and choose one of the demo profiles.
login.generic_error: We could not enter the demo. Please try again.

error.profile_unavailable: That demo profile is no longer available. Search for the customer again.
error.own_card: Choose one of your own demo credit cards.
error.credit_card_only: Only a demo credit card can be used at checkout.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.intro: Create a demo Factored Bank profile to experience the dispute journey.
signup.phone_help: Include your country code. We'll format the number automatically. This number can also be used to authenticate when calling Izzy. If another demo account already uses this number, that account and its demo data will be replaced by this new account.
signup.language_help: Factored Bank and Izzy will use this language and regional accent for your registered profile.
signup.ready: Your Factored Bank demo account and credit card are ready.
signup.try_phone: Want to try Izzy by phone?
signup.phone_id: When calling Izzy, use your six-digit Factored ID to authenticate.
signup.phone_id_initial: You can authenticate using your Factored ID when Izzy asks for it.
signup.phone_or_id: When calling Izzy, you can authenticate using either your registered phone number or your six-digit Factored ID.
signup.birth_error: Birth date must be in the past.
signup.phone_error: Enter the country code and phone number. For example: +5511981020050.
signup.generate_error: Generate your Factored ID before creating the account.
signup.generic_error: We could not create your account. Please try again.
home.question: What would you like to do today?
home.izzy_help: Izzy can help you find a transaction, understand what happened and start a complaint.
home.cards_help: View, block and manage your cards.
home.store_intro: Visit our suspicious little shop, make a demo purchase and see if everything on your statement is what you expected.
home.replay_help: Replay the short guide to Factored Bank, Shady Business and Izzy.
cards.title: Cards
cards.intro: View your cards and quickly block one if you think it may be compromised.
cards.empty_body: There are no cards associated with this Factored Bank account.
cards.blocked_help: Unblock it when you're ready to use it again.
cards.active_help: Block this card if you think it may be compromised.
cards.block_detail: Card ending in {lastFour} will no longer be available for new demo purchases until you unblock it.
cards.unblock_detail: Card ending in {lastFour} will become active and available for demo purchases again.
cards.update_error: We could not update this card. Please try again.
cards.load_error: We could not load your cards. Please try again.
transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.intro: Review your recent purchases and report anything that doesn't look right.
transactions.warning_body: We found transaction activity marked as suspicious in this demo account.
transactions.empty_body: Your transaction history will appear here.
transactions.load_error: We could not load your transactions. Please try again.
transaction.suspicious_body: This transaction is marked as suspicious in the demo data. If you don't recognize it, Izzy can help you review it.
transaction.report_help: Start a conversation with Izzy. We'll pass this transaction into the conversation so you don't have to find it again.
transaction.load_error: We could not load this transaction. Please try again.
complaints.title: Complaints
complaints.intro: Follow your complaints, disputes and their outcomes.
complaints.new_help: Start a new complaint with Izzy.
complaints.empty_body: If something goes wrong with a transaction, Izzy can help you start a complaint.
complaints.load_error: We could not load your complaints. Please try again.

complaint.more_help_body: Start a new conversation with Izzy about a payment or dispute.
complaint.pending_body: This complaint is still being reviewed.
complaint.processing: This complaint is still being processed.
complaint.no_resolution: No final resolution has been recorded yet.
complaint.load_error: We could not load this complaint. Please try again.
profile.title: Your profile
profile.intro: Keep your demo contact details and language preference current. Your Factored ID identifies this account and cannot be changed.
profile.phone_help: Use international format, including the country code.
profile.language_help: The interface changes immediately and Izzy will use this preference in future conversations.
profile.phone_format_error: Phone must use international format, for example +5511999999999.
profile.generic_error: We could not update your profile. Please try again.
profile.logout_error: We could not sign you out. Please try again.
coming.title: Coming soon
coming.body: This part of the Factored Bank experience is being prepared.
coming.complaints: Follow complaints and disputes you have opened with Factored Bank.
coming.profile: Review your Factored Bank demo identity and personal preferences.
coming.izzy: Chat with Izzy about a payment, transaction, or dispute.
coming.store: The suspicious demo shop is being prepared. Soon you'll be able to make purchases here and generate transactions to dispute.

store.hero_title: Things you never knew you should not need.
store.hero_body: Every purchase is fake. The buyer's remorse is simulated with remarkable accuracy.
store.inventory_title: Fresh from the back of a van
store.load_error: Our van is temporarily empty. Reload the page to try again.
store.product_error: We could not load this product. Please try again.
store.demo_only: Demo only. No real payment or card network is contacted.
store.no_card: You do not have an active demo credit card. Return to Factored Bank to review your cards.
store.checkout_error: We could not prepare checkout. Reload the page to try again.
store.checkout_request_error: Checkout tripped over a loose cable. Your cart is safe; please try again.
store.order_way: Your order is on its imaginary way.
store.order_message: Your simulated order is confirmed. Review your bank activity to see how the mock payment processor recorded it.
store.invisible_description: A premium umbrella made from 100% transparent imagination. Handle included; weather protection sold separately in another dimension.
store.wifi_description: Place this authentic-looking rock near your router and believe very hard. Compatible with every network because it connects to none of them.
store.escape_tagline: For calls that should have been emails.
store.escape_description: A large red button that plays a convincing doorbell sound and displays a tasteful reminder to leave the meeting.
store.air_tagline: The same air, but with leadership.
store.air_description: A sealed jar of boardroom-grade atmosphere. Notes of quarterly targets, cold coffee, and confident nodding.
store.mug_tagline: The handle is on the other side.
store.mug_description: Revolutionary ceramic engineering for left-handed drinkers. Rotate 180 degrees for an instant right-handed compatibility upgrade.
store.cloud_description: A cardboard box labeled CLOUD. Holds up to 2 TB of printed screenshots depending on font size and folding technique.
tour.activate: Select the highlighted control to continue.
tour.error: The tour could not save your progress. Try again or reload the page.
tour.welcome_body: This interactive tour will guide you through the real controls used to review and dispute a card transaction.
tour.cards_link_body: Select Cards to review the cards connected to this demo account.
tour.cards_body: Check the card status and last four digits here. If you believe the card is compromised, you can block it using the control below after the tour.
tour.transactions_link_body: Select Transactions to inspect purchases and identify a payment you want to report.
tour.transactions_body: Select a transaction to review its merchant, amount, date, channel, and location.
tour.report_body: Select this action to send the transaction to Izzy as context for the dispute conversation.
tour.izzy_body: Izzy helps customers understand payment problems and start card disputes by chat or telephone.
tour.complaints_link_body: Select Complaints to see where cases will appear after you file them.
tour.complaints_body: New judge profiles start with no complaints. After you report a payment problem with Izzy, return here to follow its status and outcome.
tour.complaint_body: Complaint details show what was reported, the current status, service dates, SLA state, and any resolution or compensation.
tour.profile_link_body: Select Profile to review the customer information used by this demo.
tour.profile_body: Contact and language preferences can be changed here. The Factored ID remains read-only.
tour.finish_body: Your first experience after this tour is to visit Shady Business and buy a funny item with the fake card. The purchase creates realistic activity that you can find and dispute in Factored Bank.
izzy.session_expired: This chat expired. Start a new chat to continue.
izzy.unavailable: I can't reach Izzy right now. Please try again in a moment or call Izzy.
izzy.page_description: Chat with Izzy, Factored Bank's virtual assistant for card disputes.
